baseline.title: Twisted relative orbital integral
baseline.description: For a relevant element γ and a unitary character μ of G^σ×G^θ trivial on its connected stabilizer,the twisted relative orbital integral integrates μ(x,y^{-1})f(x^{-1}γy) over (G_γ^{σθ})°∖(G^σ×G^θ),with compatible quotient Haar measures.

current.title: Twisted relative orbital integral
current.description: Over a local field k, for relatively semisimple γ∈G(k), put H=G^σ(k)×G^θ(k) and L=(G_γ^(σθ))°(k). Given a unitary character χ of H trivial on L and compatible Haar measures, the twisted relative orbital integral is ∫_(L∖H)χ(x,y)f(x⁻¹γy)d[x,y], for compactly supported smooth f. In the convention χ(x,y)=μ₁(x)μ₂(y)⁻¹, relevance requires this actual character to be trivial on L. The adelic version replaces local points by adelic points and is defined when the integral converges.
